(()=>{const out=[];for(const tr of [14,19]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[],trackRace:true});RACE.state='race';const c=RACE.cars[0];const G=PT8.gearTops(c.cs);const ip0=PT8.inPost;let ST=0;PT8.inPost=(cc,dt)=>{if(cc.human){cc.in={th:.5,br:0,st:ST,hb:0}}if(ip0)ip0(cc,dt)};const T=RACE.T;const res=[];for(const g of [0,1,2]){for(const f of [.5,.8]){const v=G[g]*f*(g?1:1);const k=40;c.x=T.x[k];c.z=T.z[k];c.y=T.y[k]+.3;c.yaw=Math.atan2(T.x[k+1]-T.x[k],T.z[k+1]-T.z[k]);c.vx=Math.sin(c.yaw)*v;c.vz=Math.cos(c.yaw)*v;c.vy=0;c.yr=0;c.sp=v;c.gear=g;c.rg=g;ST=0;for(let i=0;i<10;i++)step(1/60);const y0=c.yaw,h0=Math.atan2(c.vx,c.vz);ST=1;let t=0;for(let i=0;i<40;i++){step(1/60);c.gear=g;c.rg=g}const h1=Math.atan2(c.vx,c.vz);let dh=h1-h0;while(dh>Math.PI)dh-=2*Math.PI;while(dh<-Math.PI)dh+=2*Math.PI;const w=Math.abs(dh)/(40/60);res.push('g'+(g+1)+'@'+Math.round(c.sp*2.237*PT8.dialK())+'mph '+Math.round(w*57.3)+'deg/s R'+Math.round(c.sp/Math.max(w,1e-3))+'m')}}PT8.inPost=ip0;out.push(tr+': '+res.join(' | '));PT8.cleanupRace()}return out.join('\n')})()
